query:
WITH non_saudi_population AS (
  SELECT 
    TRIM(nationality) as nationality,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id, dependent_seq_no) as count_by_nationality
  FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala
  WHERE snapshot = '2026-02-01' 
    AND TRIM(person_type) != 'Saudi'
    AND is_in_population = TRUE
  GROUP BY TRIM(nationality)
),
total_non_saudi AS (
  SELECT SUM(count_by_nationality) as total_count
  FROM non_saudi_population
)
SELECT 
  np.nationality,
  np.count_by_nationality,
  ROUND((np.count_by_nationality * 100.0 / tp.total_count), 2) as percentage
FROM non_saudi_population np
CROSS JOIN total_non_saudi tp
ORDER BY np.count_by_nationality DESC
LIMIT 10
